content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

The proposed infrastructure works because it is built on open-source and decentralized technologies, allowing creators to maintain full ownership and control over their digital commerce stack. This approach eliminates the need for intermediaries like Stripe and PayPal, which often impose restrictive policies and high fees. For instance, Gumroad charges a 10% fee on every sale, whereas NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, resulting in significant savings for creators.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need to have a clear understanding of your product offerings, target audience, and marketing strategy. You also need to set up a GitHub account, create a Cloudflare Workers script, and configure your NOWPayments account. Additionally, you should have a basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to customize your storefront and integrate it with your payment and delivery pipeline.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you need to integrate your NOWPayments account with your Cloudflare Workers script. This involves generating a payment gateway API key, configuring your cryptocurrency pricing, and setting up automatic webhook notifications. You also need to configure your digital product delivery system, which can be done using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This will enable instant delivery of your digital products to customers upon payment confirmation.
Leverage a sovereign digital commerce stack to eliminate intermediaries and maintain full ownership and control over your digital commerce infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live with your storefront and start processing transactions. This involves testing your payment gateway, configuring your storefront, and setting up analytics to track your sales and customer interactions. You should also have a clear understanding of how to handle customer support and refunds, which can be done using your NOWPayments account and Cloudflare Workers script.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

To scale your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need to focus on optimizing your storefront, improving your marketing strategy, and expanding your product offerings. You can also leverage the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, to build, deploy, and scale your digital commerce infrastructure. This will enable you to increase your sales, reduce your costs, and maintain full ownership and control over your digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can use a sovereign digital commerce stack that utilizes GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. This approach eliminates the need for intermediaries and allows creators to maintain full ownership and control over their digital commerce stack. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies and pay a fee of only 0.5% per transaction.

If you're looking for a comprehensive solution to build, deploy, and scale your digital commerce infrastructure, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, providing you with everything you need to create a sovereign digital commerce stack and start selling your ebooks and other digital products online.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: set up your GitHub account and create a new repository, configure your Cloudflare Workers script and integrate it with your NOWPayments account, customize your storefront using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, configure your digital product delivery system using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, test your payment gateway and configure your storefront, and go live with your storefront and start processing transactions. You can also leverage the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to streamline your deployment process and get instant access to all the necessary blueprints and templates.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the fee for using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a fee of only 0.5% per transaction, which is significantly lower than the fees charged by intermediaries like Gumroad and Stripe.
Can I use this infrastructure to sell other digital products?
Yes, you can use this infrastructure to sell other digital products like courses, templates, fonts, and software. The proposed solution is versatile and can be customized to meet your specific needs.
Do I need to have programming skills to deploy this infrastructure?

You need to have basic programming skills in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to customize your storefront and integrate it with your payment and delivery pipeline. However, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides you with all the necessary blueprints and templates to streamline your deployment process.
How do I handle customer support and refunds?

You can handle customer support and refunds using your NOWPayments account and Cloudflare Workers script. You can also set up a support email and provide clear instructions to customers on how to request refunds and resolve issues.
Can I scale this infrastructure to meet growing demand?

Yes, you can scale this infrastructure to meet growing demand by optimizing your storefront, improving your marketing strategy, and expanding your product offerings.
